stories.start_quote: יד נתן וכותב כי הה״ק ר׳ יוסף
stories.summary_en: R. Yosef 'Ish Emet' sends a Pentateuch from the Holy Land lamenting his father R. Moshe, who was martyred in a blood libel. Impaled on a stake near Sabbath eve after a week-long fast, R. Moshe sang hymns and felt no pain from the strength of his cleaving to God.
